input.value: ExecutionContext instance with empty Annotations map

cases.expected: Annotations map contains exactly one JsonNodeAnnotation whose evaluationPath equals validator.evaluationPath, schemaLocation equals validator.schemaLocation, keyword equals validator.getKeyword(), and all optional fields are null/default
cases.description: Verifies that when the customizer does not modify the builder, the annotation stored contains only the automatically populated fields (evaluationPath, schemaLocation, keyword).
When the provided ExecutionContext is null, the method attempts to call getAnnotations() and throws a NullPointerException.
